content.user_title: Create Xiaohongshu Posts and Live Photos
content.value_statement: Preparing Xiaohongshu copy, images, and wording reviews requires several separate steps. This skill coordinates RedYA API workflows with outline approval, image generation, Live Photos, and sensitive-word checks.
actual_capabilities: Generate and revise titles, body copy, and page descriptions before submitting approved outlines for image generation.
Poll image tasks, display completed pages, and request approved regeneration of individual failed pages.
Parse supported social links and use selected knowledge bases or product profiles as generation references.
Convert supplied images into Live Photos with available camera effects or quoted AI motion options.
Check sensitive wording, apply confirmed replacements, and manage the account owner's personal word list.
Check account credits and quotas, preserve UTF-8 request text, and recover existing Live Photo tasks.
limitations: Requires a RedYA account, API key, network access, and available credits for paid operations.
Requests send selected text and media to external services; RedYA retains all generation records.
Posts support at most 15 pages; parsed sources expire after 72 hours, and image links should be copied within seven days.
Does not automatically publish posts, guarantee platform approval, or import downloaded Live Photos into a phone album.

use_cases.title: Prepare an illustrated post
use_cases.description: Review a title, body, and page plan before generating images for a Xiaohongshu post.

use_cases.title: Build product content
use_cases.description: Create a product profile from supplied image links, select a writing style, and revise the resulting product post.

use_cases.title: Review campaign assets
use_cases.description: Check draft wording and convert approved campaign images into Live Photos with clear cost authorization.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a first outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a Xiaohongshu post about [topic]. Show the title, body, and page descriptions before generating any images.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review an outline before image generation.

prompt_templates.title: Review sensitive wording
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this draft for sensitive wording: [text]. Explain the fee first, then show findings and await my approval before replacements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review copy without publishing it.

prompt_templates.title: Create product content
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product profile from [image URLs]. Draft a post using [selected knowledge base], preserve unchanged pages during revisions, and await image approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate product assets and selected references.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an image batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [images] into AI Live Photos. Show models and prices for approval, save each request UUID, recover uncertain tasks, and download completed files.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage paid batch conversion without duplicate submissions.

output_examples.input: Draft a three-page Xiaohongshu post about organizing a small desk. Do not generate images yet.
output: Title: A Simple Plan for a Tidy Small Desk
Body: Keep daily tools within reach. Separate cables and leave a clear working area.
Page 1: Cover showing an organized compact desk.
Page 2: Storage layout for frequently used items.
Page 3: Cable management and a final checklist.
Awaiting outline approval before image generation.

output_examples.input: Show how you would report a five-page image task where page four failed.
output: Page 4 failed. The completed pages remain available.
Would you like to regenerate only page 4?

output_examples.input: Show an example wording review for: This product guarantees perfect results.
output: Reason: This wording makes an absolute outcome claim.
Confirm the replacement before applying it. A wording check does not guarantee platform approval.

best_practices: Store the API key outside chat and use only a trusted HTTPS service address, including any configured private deployment.
Review fees and selected source materials before submitting requests; approve outlines before paid image generation.
Save task identifiers, preserve UTF-8 text, and query existing requests before retrying uncertain operations.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential materials or private knowledge bases without permission to send them to the external service.
Do not repeatedly resubmit uncertain tasks or create new Live Photo identifiers after a timeout.
Do not treat wording checks as legal approval, downloaded files as imported albums, or generated drafts as published posts.

faq.question: What must I configure first?
faq.answer: Create a RedYA account and API key, then set REDYA_API_KEY in your environment. Stop on missing credentials or authentication errors.

faq.question: Which operations use credits?
faq.answer: Outlines, images, successful source parsing, wording checks, and AI Live Photos can use credits. Basic Live Photo camera effects are documented as free.

faq.question: Can I revise copy before generating images?
faq.answer: Yes. The default workflow shows the outline first, applies requested changes, and waits for approval before image generation.

faq.question: Which source platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The documentation lists Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat public articles, Kuaishou, and Bilibili. Parsing can fail, and results expire after 72 hours.

faq.question: Does a sensitive-word check ensure approval?
faq.answer: No. Checks provide findings and replacement suggestions. You remain responsible for claims, compliance, and publication decisions.

faq.question: Are my content and files processed locally?
faq.answer: No. Selected content is sent to RedYA services, and generation records are retained. Request files and completed Live Photo downloads are saved locally.
